preconditions.description: The number of photos n must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of albums m must be between 1 and 40.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each album must contain between 1 and 1000 photos.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(ai > (n + 1) // 2 for ai in a) else True
postconditions.description: If any album has more than half the total photos, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(t) <= m for t in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output must contain n album numbers, each between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) != int(stdout.split()[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)) and int(stdout.split()[0]) != int(stdout.split()[-1])
postconditions.description: No two neighboring photos in the output can be from the same album.
